name: Peredur

attributes.attribute: a Welsh hero who became the basis for Percival

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Peredur is a Welsh and Arthurian hero. In one of the great Welsh romances he is a callow young man. After many trials and quests he became a noble, admired knight. His character, changed in some ways, became the basis for the Arthurian hero Percival. Some see in his name an echo of the grail, for per means bowl in Brythonic Celtic. Yet a true link to the Grail is shown in no usual version of his tale.

okr.objective: Present Peredur as the Welsh forerunner of Percival.
